draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.32, the 47th-best grade among 257 2026 draftees and 8th of 36 at WR. He lasted until pick 79, well after his grade rank (47th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Curtis Samuel. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (88th percentile), 10-yard split (82nd percentile). College production: 811 receiving yards in 2025, 18th of 36 WRs in his class with stats.
